end.summary:
- Practised linking bird beak and foot shapes with feeding and movement.
- Identified webbed duck feet as useful for swimming and spreading weight on soft ground.
- Practised linking leaf and plant features with habitat; this still needs checking next time.
- Some bird-feeding choices changed during discussion and were not steady yet.
end.parentNote: Atharv practised using beak and foot features to explain how birds eat and move. They used webbed duck feet to connect joined toes with swimming and spreading weight, and this idea was corrected after an earlier choice. Plant leaf features and habitat links were also practised but were not steady yet. At home, look at two nearby plants and ask Atharv to name one leaf feature and suggest where that feature helps the plant live.
